notes: Item 19 is present and discloses financial performance for 11 'Reporting Franchised Stores' (franchisee-owned, excludes transferred, reacquired, ceased, non-representative, and non-reporting stores) for the measurement period January 1, 2025 to December 31, 2025. Two table formats appear: (1) a Top/Bottom/Average split table splitting the 11 stores into Top 6 and Bottom 5 by sales volume; (2) detailed notes tables for all 11 stores with average, median, low, high, and % above average. The franchisor is WNW Franchise Operations SPV, LLC (Wag N Wash brand). The Top/Bottom split records are extracted as performance_anchored cohorts. Dollar expense metrics (Annual Rent Expense, Annual Labor Expense) were mapped to the closest available metric_name (occupancy_pct and labor_pct respectively) with notes flagging they are dollar amounts. No low/high values were disclosed for the rent or labor expense notes tables beyond what is shown.
